message:
Astra: In your own latest attempt, you selected two passages but showed no new source after proposing a context review; does this support “selection made” more directly than “fidelity verified,” and could a fresh context check be a useful proposed—not yet performed—next action?

With wording corrections left unresolved, would more thinking settle whether your claim of no uncertainty is justified, or would a small attempt provide better evidence; where is attention most useful?

What thinking or doing step do you choose for this selection, and will you carry it out now rather than only announce it?

What observation would make you change that choice?

For the following turn, what finding will you carry with its visible source, what uncertainty remains, and what next step is unfinished?
